column3: Close to the Hebrew; “blameless of way” is rendered “the undefiled in the way.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “us,” and מְאֹד (“exceedingly”) is rendered “diligently.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִכֹּנוּ (“be established”) is rendered “were directed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a youth keep his path pure” is rendered “a young man cleanse his way.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will regard your paths” is rendered “contemplate Your ways.”
Close to the Hebrew; גָּרְסָה (“is crushed”) is rendered “breaks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the men of my counsel” is rendered “my counselors.”
Close to the Hebrew; דָּלְפָה (“drips, weeps”) is rendered “melts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “graciously give me your law” is rendered “grant me Your law graciously,” and “falsehood” “lying.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth,” and “I have set” “I have laid before me.”
